t: 雇佣兵加泰罗尼亚公司的领导人罗杰·德·弗洛尔被谋杀,导致雇佣兵在色雷斯大肆掠夺.
te: Roger de Flor, leader of the mercenary Catalan Company, is murdered, leading to widespread pillaging by the mercenaries…
dz: 雇佣兵加泰罗尼亚公司的领导人罗杰·德·弗洛尔被谋杀,导致雇佣兵在色雷斯大肆掠夺.
de: Roger de Flor, leader of the mercenary Catalan Company, is murdered, leading to widespread pillaging by the mercenaries in Thrace.

t: 在上一年教宗本笃十一世去世后,选举教宗克莱门特五世.
te: Election of Pope Clement V following the death of Pope Benedict XI in the previous year.
dz: 在上一年教宗本笃十一世去世后,选举教宗克莱门特五世.
de: Election of Pope Clement V following the death of Pope Benedict XI in the previous year.

t: 弗拉芒人和法国人在奥尔日河畔阿斯签订和平条约.
te: A peace treaty between the Flemish and the French is signed at Athis-sur-Orge.
dz: 弗拉芒人和法国人在奥尔日河畔阿斯签订和平条约.
de: A peace treaty between the Flemish and the French is signed at Athis-sur-Orge.

t: 孟特斯的约翰·斯图尔特爵士(Sir John Stewart of Menteith)是邓巴顿…
te: Sir John Stewart of Menteith, the pro-English Sheriff of Dumbarton, successfully manages to capture Sir William Wallace…
dz: 第一次苏格兰独立战争:孟特斯的约翰·斯图尔特爵士(Sir John Stewart of Menteith)是邓巴顿的亲英国警长,他成功地设法俘获了苏格兰的威廉·华莱士爵士,导致华莱士随后被绞死,被刺杀,被绘出并被扎营,18天后被斩首.
de: First Scottish War of Independence: Sir John Stewart of Menteith, the pro-English Sheriff of Dumbarton, successfully manages to capture Sir William Wallace of Scotland, leading to Wallace's subsequent execution by hanging, evisceration, drawing and quartering, and beheading 18 days later.

t: 威廉·华莱士受到审判，随后被绞死、抽搐并分尸。
te: William Wallace is put on trial and subsequently hanged, drawn and quartered.
dz: 威廉·华莱士受到审判，随后被绞死、抽搐并分尸。
de: William Wallace is put on trial and subsequently hanged, drawn and quartered.
